description: Create a landing page from objective definition through launch and conversion tracking.

steps.description: Define the landing page objective, target audience, and success metrics.

inputs.name: campaign-context
inputs.desc: The campaign or product the landing page supports

outputs.name: page-objective
outputs.desc: The single action the page should drive (signup, download, purchase)

outputs.name: audience-profile
outputs.desc: Summary of the target audience's needs and motivations

process: Identify the one action the page should drive.
Describe the target audience and what matters to them.
Define the success metric (conversion rate target, signups per week).

steps.description: Write the landing page headline, subhead, body copy, and call to action.

inputs.name: page-objective
inputs.desc: The single action the page should drive

inputs.name: audience-profile
inputs.desc: Who the page is for and what they care about

outputs.name: page-copy
outputs.desc: All text for the page: headline, subhead, benefits, social proof, CTA

outputs.name: cta-text
outputs.desc: The call-to-action button text and supporting microcopy

process: Write a headline that states the value proposition in the audience's language.
Write the subhead, benefit bullets, and social proof section.
Write the call-to-action text and any supporting microcopy.
Review for clarity and remove any filler.

steps.description: Design the page layout: hero section, benefits, social proof, and CTA placement.

inputs.name: page-copy
inputs.desc: All the written content for the page

outputs.name: page-wireframe
outputs.desc: Section-by-section layout of the page

outputs.name: design-specs
outputs.desc: Color palette, typography, and image direction

process: Lay out the hero section with headline, subhead, and primary CTA.
Arrange the benefits section and social proof below the fold.
Place a secondary CTA at the bottom of the page.
Specify the visual direction (colors, fonts, imagery style).

steps.description: Build the landing page using the selected tool or platform.

outputs.name: built-page
outputs.desc: The functioning landing page ready for testing

outputs.name: page-url
outputs.desc: The URL where the page is accessible

process: Build the page following the wireframe and design specs.
Add images, icons, and any interactive elements.
Test the page on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Verify the form or CTA works correctly.

steps.description: Set up conversion tracking, analytics events, and A/B test variants.

outputs.name: tracking-config
outputs.desc: Analytics events and conversion goals configured

outputs.name: launch-report
outputs.desc: Confirmation that the page is live with tracking active

process: Add analytics tracking (page views, scroll depth, time on page).
Set up conversion event tracking on the form or CTA.
Configure any A/B test variants if planned.
Verify all events fire correctly in a test submission.

description: Migrate content between CMS platforms from inventory through redirect verification.

steps.description: Inventory all content in the current CMS: pages, posts, media, metadata, and taxonomy.

inputs.name: source-cms
inputs.desc: The current CMS platform and access details

inputs.name: migration-scope
inputs.desc: Which content types and sections to migrate

outputs.name: content-inventory
outputs.desc: Complete list of all content items with URLs, types, and metadata

outputs.name: media-inventory
outputs.desc: List of all media files (images, documents, videos) with paths

process: Export or crawl the full list of pages, posts, and custom content types.
Record each item's URL, title, status, author, dates, and taxonomy.
Inventory all media files and their associations to content.
Note any custom fields, shortcodes, or platform-specific features.

steps.description: Map the source content model to the target CMS structure.

inputs.name: media-inventory
inputs.desc: All media files and their associations

outputs.name: content-mapping
outputs.desc: Field-by-field mapping from source to target CMS

outputs.name: migration-exceptions
outputs.desc: Items that cannot map directly and need manual handling

process: Map each content type in the source to its equivalent in the target.
Map fields, taxonomies, and custom metadata.
Identify items that have no direct equivalent and document the workaround.
Document any content that needs transformation (shortcodes, embeds).

steps.description: Export and transform content from the source CMS into the target format.

inputs.name: content-mapping
inputs.desc: Field mapping from source to target

outputs.name: export-package
outputs.desc: Transformed content ready for import into the target CMS

outputs.name: export-log
outputs.desc: Record of what was exported and any issues encountered

process: Export all content from the source CMS.
Transform the content according to the mapping document.
Handle exceptions (shortcode conversion, embed replacement).
Package the content for import into the target.

steps.description: Import the content into the target CMS and verify integrity.

outputs.name: import-report
outputs.desc: Summary of imported items with success and failure counts

outputs.name: imported-url-map
outputs.desc: Mapping of old URLs to new URLs

process: Import the content package into the target CMS.
Verify the item count matches the source inventory.
Check that media files, images, and links are intact.
Record the old-to-new URL mapping for redirects.

steps.description: Configure redirects from old URLs to new URLs and verify they resolve.

inputs.name: imported-url-map
inputs.desc: Old URL to new URL mapping

outputs.name: redirect-rules
outputs.desc: All 301 redirect rules configured and tested

outputs.name: migration-checklist
outputs.desc: Final checklist confirming all content migrated and redirects active

process: Create 301 redirect rules for every changed URL.
Test a sample of redirects to verify they resolve correctly.
Check for redirect chains or loops and fix them.
Produce the final migration checklist with sign-off items.

description: Prepare and launch a website with all quality, performance, and tracking checks completed.

steps.description: Verify all website content is final, proofread, and correctly formatted.

inputs.name: site-url
inputs.desc: The staging or preview URL of the site

inputs.name: content-list
inputs.desc: List of pages and content items to check

outputs.name: content-issues
outputs.desc: Any content problems found (typos, placeholder text, broken images)

outputs.name: content-signoff
outputs.desc: Confirmation that content is ready for launch

process: Review every page for placeholder text, lorem ipsum, or draft content.
Check all images for alt text, correct sizing, and proper loading.
Verify all internal links work and external links open correctly.
Proofread headings, body text, and microcopy for errors.

steps.description: Test all forms, interactive elements, and user flows.

outputs.name: functional-issues
outputs.desc: Any broken forms, buttons, or interactive elements

outputs.name: functional-signoff
outputs.desc: Confirmation that all interactive elements work

process: Submit every form with valid and invalid data to test validation.
Test navigation, dropdowns, modals, and interactive components.
Verify email notifications, confirmations, and thank-you pages.
Test on multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).

steps.description: Check page speed, mobile responsiveness, and Core Web Vitals.

outputs.name: performance-report
outputs.desc: Page speed scores, Core Web Vitals, and mobile test results

outputs.name: performance-fixes
outputs.desc: List of performance issues to address before launch

process: Run page speed tests on key pages (homepage, landing pages, forms).
Check Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) against thresholds.
Test responsive layout on phone, tablet, and desktop viewports.
Identify and prioritize any performance issues.

steps.description: Configure SSL, security headers, and basic hardening before launch.

outputs.name: security-config
outputs.desc: SSL, headers, and security settings confirmed

outputs.name: security-checklist
outputs.desc: Checklist of security items verified

process: Verify SSL certificate is installed and all pages load over HTTPS.
Configure security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options).
Ensure no sensitive files are publicly accessible (config files, .env, backups).
Set up HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects.

steps.description: Set up analytics, search console, and submit the sitemap, then launch.

outputs.name: analytics-config
outputs.desc: Analytics and search console configured

outputs.name: launch-checklist
outputs.desc: Complete launch checklist with all items signed off

process: Install and verify analytics tracking on all pages.
Register the site with search console and submit the sitemap.
Set up uptime monitoring and error alerting.
Switch DNS or remove the maintenance page to go live.

description: Set up uptime, performance, error, and SSL monitoring for a website.

steps.description: Set up uptime monitoring with HTTP checks and ping tests.

outputs.name: uptime-config
outputs.desc: Configured uptime checks with intervals and thresholds

outputs.name: alert-contacts
outputs.desc: Who gets notified and through what channel

process: Configure HTTP checks for each endpoint (homepage, API, login, key pages).
Set the check interval based on the SLA target.
Define the failure threshold (consecutive failures before alerting).
Configure notification channels (email, SMS, Slack, PagerDuty).

steps.description: Set up page speed and Core Web Vitals monitoring.

outputs.name: performance-monitors
outputs.desc: Configured speed and vitals checks

outputs.name: performance-baselines
outputs.desc: Baseline scores to detect regressions

process: Set up scheduled page speed tests on key pages.
Configure Core Web Vitals monitoring (LCP, INP, CLS).
Record baseline scores for each page.
Set alert thresholds for performance regressions.

steps.description: Set up error tracking (4xx, 5xx) and SSL certificate expiry alerts.

outputs.name: error-tracking-config
outputs.desc: Error monitoring for HTTP status codes and exceptions

outputs.name: ssl-monitoring-config
outputs.desc: SSL expiry alerts configured

process: Configure monitoring for 4xx and 5xx HTTP error rates.
Set up SSL certificate expiry alerts (30-day, 14-day, 7-day warnings).
Configure exception tracking for server-side errors if applicable.
Route all alerts through the defined notification channels.

steps.description: Set up synthetic user journey checks that simulate key user flows.

outputs.name: synthetic-checks
outputs.desc: Automated user journey checks configured

outputs.name: monitoring-setup-document
outputs.desc: Complete monitoring setup with all checks documented

process: Identify the critical user journeys (signup, login, checkout, search).
Build synthetic checks that simulate each journey end to end.
Set the run schedule and failure thresholds.
Document the full monitoring setup with escalation procedures.

description: Build a no-code app prototype from requirements through user testing.

steps.description: Define the app's purpose, target users, and core user flows.

inputs.name: app-idea
inputs.desc: Description of what the app should do

outputs.name: app-requirements
outputs.desc: List of features and user stories

outputs.name: user-flows
outputs.desc: The main paths a user takes through the app

process: Clarify the app's core purpose in one sentence.
List the must-have features for the first version.
Map the primary user flows from entry to completion.
Identify any data the app needs to store or retrieve.

steps.description: Select the no-code platform based on the app requirements.

outputs.name: platform-choice
outputs.desc: The selected no-code platform with rationale

outputs.name: platform-constraints
outputs.desc: Limitations of the chosen platform to design around

process: Evaluate platform options against the feature requirements.
Consider data model complexity, integrations needed, and deployment options.
Note the platform's limitations and how they affect the design.
Select the platform and document the rationale.

steps.description: Design the data model: tables, fields, relationships, and access rules.

outputs.name: data-model
outputs.desc: Tables, fields, types, and relationships

outputs.name: access-rules
outputs.desc: Who can read and write each data type

process: Define the tables or collections the app needs.
Specify the fields, data types, and relationships between tables.
Set up access rules (who can create, read, update, delete).
Add sample data for testing.

steps.description: Build the screens, navigation, and interactive elements.

outputs.name: built-prototype
outputs.desc: The working prototype with all screens and navigation

outputs.name: prototype-url
outputs.desc: URL to access the prototype

process: Build each screen following the user flow sequence.
Connect screens to the data model (forms write, lists read).
Add navigation between screens.
Test each flow end to end with the sample data.

steps.description: Test the prototype with sample users and document findings.

outputs.name: test-findings
outputs.desc: Usability issues and feedback from testers

outputs.name: prototype-documentation
outputs.desc: Documentation of the prototype's features, data model, and known limitations

process: Have 3 to 5 people walk through the main user flows.
Observe where they get stuck or confused.
Record the issues and prioritize fixes.
Document the prototype's current state, limitations, and next steps.

description: Prepare and submit a mobile app to the app store, from listing through review response.

steps.description: Prepare the app store listing: title, description, keywords, screenshots, and icon.

outputs.name: listing-package
outputs.desc: Title, subtitle, description, keywords, screenshots, and icon

outputs.name: keyword-strategy
outputs.desc: Selected keywords and their rationale

process: Write the app title and subtitle within character limits.
Write the description with the key features in the first three lines.
Research and select keywords based on search volume and competition.
Prepare screenshots showing the main features and icon in required sizes.

steps.description: Complete the required developer forms: privacy policy, content rating, and data safety.

outputs.name: compliance-forms
outputs.desc: All required forms completed (privacy policy, content rating, data safety declarations)

outputs.name: privacy-policy-url
outputs.desc: URL of the published privacy policy

process: Write or update the privacy policy covering all data the app collects.
Complete the content rating questionnaire.
Fill out the data safety section (what data is collected, how it is used, whether it is shared).
Publish the privacy policy at a public URL.

steps.description: Upload the app build and configure distribution settings.

outputs.name: uploaded-build
outputs.desc: Build uploaded and associated with the store listing

outputs.name: distribution-settings
outputs.desc: Pricing, countries, and release type configured

process: Build the release version of the app.
Upload the build to the app store console.
Configure pricing, country availability, and release type (immediate or phased).
Associate the build with the prepared listing.

steps.description: Submit the app for review and respond to any reviewer feedback.

outputs.name: review-status
outputs.desc: Current review status and any reviewer notes

outputs.name: submission-checklist
outputs.desc: Complete record of what was submitted and when

process: Submit the app for review with any reviewer notes.
Monitor the review status for approval or rejection.
If rejected, address the specific issues cited and resubmit.
Document the submission timeline and outcome.

description: Conduct a technical SEO audit covering crawlability, speed, mobile usability, and structured data.

steps.description: Crawl the site to identify indexation issues, crawl errors, and orphan pages.

inputs.name: audit-scope
inputs.desc: Which sections or subdomains to include

outputs.name: crawl-report
outputs.desc: All pages found with status codes, canonical tags, and index directives

outputs.name: crawl-issues
outputs.desc: Errors, warnings, and orphan pages identified

process: Crawl the site following internal links from the homepage.
Record each page's HTTP status, canonical tag, robots directive, and title.
Identify crawl errors (4xx, 5xx), redirect chains, and duplicate content.
Flag orphan pages (not linked from any other page).

steps.description: Audit the robots.txt and sitemap configuration.

outputs.name: robots-findings
outputs.desc: Issues in robots.txt (blocking important pages, missing directives)

outputs.name: sitemap-findings
outputs.desc: Sitemap issues (missing pages, incorrect URLs, stale entries)

process: Check robots.txt for rules that block important pages or resources.
Verify the sitemap includes all indexable pages and excludes non-indexable ones.
Cross-reference the sitemap against the crawl report for missing or extra URLs.
Check sitemap format, size limits, and last-modified dates.

steps.description: Audit page speed and Core Web Vitals across key pages.

outputs.name: speed-report
outputs.desc: Page speed scores and Core Web Vitals for each tested page

outputs.name: speed-fixes
outputs.desc: Prioritized list of speed improvements

process: Test the top pages (by traffic or importance) for load speed.
Measure Core Web Vitals: Largest Contentful Paint, Interaction to Next Paint, Cumulative Layout Shift.
Identify the largest contributors to slow load times (images, scripts, fonts, server response).
Prioritize fixes by impact.

steps.description: Audit mobile usability: viewport, tap targets, font sizes, and responsive layout.

outputs.name: mobile-findings
outputs.desc: Mobile usability issues found

outputs.name: mobile-fixes
outputs.desc: Fixes prioritized by impact on mobile users

process: Check viewport meta tag configuration.
Test tap target sizes and spacing.
Verify font sizes are readable without zooming.
Test layout on multiple phone screen sizes.

steps.description: Review structured data and schema markup for correctness and coverage.

outputs.name: schema-findings
outputs.desc: Structured data errors, warnings, and missing markup

outputs.name: seo-technical-report
outputs.desc: Complete technical SEO audit report with all findings prioritized

process: Validate existing structured data for syntax errors.
Check that schema types match the page content (Article, Product, FAQ, LocalBusiness).
Identify pages that should have structured data but do not.
Compile all findings into the final technical SEO report, prioritized by impact.

description: Audit a website for accessibility against WCAG 2.1 AA, from automated scans through manual testing.

steps.description: Run automated accessibility scans to catch machine-detectable issues.

inputs.name: pages-to-test
inputs.desc: List of pages or page types to include in the audit

outputs.name: automated-findings
outputs.desc: Issues found by automated tools (missing alt text, contrast failures, missing labels)

outputs.name: scan-coverage
outputs.desc: What percentage of WCAG criteria the automated scan covers

process: Run an automated scanner (axe, WAVE, Lighthouse accessibility) on each page.
Categorize findings by WCAG criterion and severity (critical, serious, moderate, minor).
Note which criteria the automated scan cannot test (they require manual review).
De-duplicate findings across pages.

steps.description: Test keyboard navigation: tab order, focus visibility, and interactive element access.

outputs.name: keyboard-findings
outputs.desc: Keyboard navigation issues (focus traps, missing focus indicators, illogical tab order)

outputs.name: interactive-element-status
outputs.desc: Which interactive elements are and are not keyboard accessible

process: Tab through each page and verify all interactive elements are reachable.
Check that focus indicators are visible on every focused element.
Test for keyboard traps (places where tab gets stuck).
Verify that custom components (dropdowns, modals, accordions) work with keyboard alone.

steps.description: Test with a screen reader to verify content is announced correctly.

outputs.name: screen-reader-findings
outputs.desc: Issues with how content is announced (missing labels, incorrect reading order, unlabeled images)

outputs.name: aria-issues
outputs.desc: Incorrect or missing ARIA attributes

process: Navigate each page with a screen reader (NVDA, VoiceOver, or JAWS).
Verify that headings, landmarks, and page structure are announced correctly.
Check that images have meaningful alt text and decorative images are hidden.
Test forms to verify labels, error messages, and instructions are announced.

steps.description: Prioritize all findings by impact and effort, and produce the audit report.

outputs.name: prioritized-fixes
outputs.desc: All issues ranked by impact and effort

outputs.name: accessibility-audit-report
outputs.desc: Complete accessibility audit report with findings, recommendations, and remediation plan

process: Combine all findings from automated, keyboard, and screen reader testing.
Rate each issue by user impact (how many users affected, how severely) and fix effort.
Group fixes into immediate (critical blockers), short-term (serious issues), and long-term (moderate and minor).
Compile the audit report with findings, WCAG references, and a remediation timeline.

description: Register a domain and configure DNS, CDN, and email routing from scratch.

steps.description: Register or transfer the domain and access the DNS management panel.

inputs.name: domain-name
inputs.desc: The domain to register or transfer

outputs.name: domain-registration
outputs.desc: Confirmation of domain ownership and registrar access

outputs.name: nameserver-config
outputs.desc: Current nameserver configuration

process: Check domain availability or initiate transfer with auth code.
Register the domain or complete the transfer.
Verify ownership and access the DNS management panel.
Note the current nameserver configuration.

steps.description: Configure all DNS records: A, CNAME, MX, TXT, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.

outputs.name: dns-records
outputs.desc: All DNS records configured

outputs.name: email-routing
outputs.desc: MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records configured for email

process: Set A or CNAME records pointing to the hosting provider.
Configure MX records for email delivery.
Add SPF, DKIM, and DMARC TXT records for email authentication.
Add any additional TXT records for service verification (Google, analytics).

steps.description: Set up the CDN and SSL certificate.

outputs.name: cdn-config
outputs.desc: CDN configured and caching rules set

outputs.name: ssl-config
outputs.desc: SSL certificate installed and HTTPS enforced

process: Set up the CDN provider and point DNS to its edge servers.
Configure caching rules for static assets.
Issue and install the SSL certificate.
Enforce HTTPS with redirect rules.

steps.description: Verify DNS propagation and document the final configuration.

outputs.name: propagation-status
outputs.desc: Verification that DNS has propagated globally

outputs.name: domain-setup-record
outputs.desc: Complete documentation of all DNS records, CDN settings, and SSL configuration

process: Check DNS propagation from multiple global locations.
Verify the site loads correctly over HTTPS.
Send a test email and verify delivery and authentication headers.
Document the full DNS configuration for the domain record.

description: Redesign a website from current-state audit through launch of the new design.

steps.description: Audit the current site using analytics, heatmaps, and user feedback.

inputs.name: redesign-motivation
inputs.desc: Why the redesign is happening (low conversions, outdated design, rebrand)

outputs.name: current-state-audit
outputs.desc: Summary of current performance, usability issues, and user feedback

outputs.name: redesign-opportunities
outputs.desc: Specific areas where the redesign can improve outcomes

process: Review analytics for traffic patterns, bounce rates, and conversion data.
Analyze heatmaps and session recordings for user behavior.
Collect user feedback from surveys, support tickets, or interviews.
Identify the top problems and opportunities for improvement.

steps.description: Define the redesign goals, success metrics, and constraints.

outputs.name: redesign-goals
outputs.desc: Specific, measurable goals for the redesign

outputs.name: success-metrics
outputs.desc: How success will be measured post-launch

process: Set specific goals tied to the audit findings (increase conversion by X%, reduce bounce rate by Y%).
Define the success metrics and measurement timeline.
Identify constraints (budget, timeline, technical platform).
Get stakeholder alignment on goals before proceeding.

steps.description: Create the new site's information architecture: sitemap, navigation, and content hierarchy.

outputs.name: site-architecture
outputs.desc: New sitemap, navigation structure, and page hierarchy

outputs.name: content-plan
outputs.desc: What content to keep, rewrite, merge, or remove

process: Map the new sitemap based on user needs and business goals.
Design the navigation (primary, secondary, footer) for clarity.
Decide what content to keep, rewrite, consolidate, or remove.
Validate the architecture against the top user tasks.

steps.description: Design wireframes and visual mockups for key page templates.

outputs.name: wireframes
outputs.desc: Wireframes for each page template

outputs.name: visual-mockups
outputs.desc: High-fidelity mockups showing the final visual design

process: Wireframe the key page templates (homepage, landing, product/service, about, contact).
Apply the visual design (brand colors, typography, imagery style).
Design for mobile-first, then adapt to larger viewports.
Review mockups against the redesign goals and user feedback.

steps.description: Build the new site, test it, and launch with redirects from the old pages.

outputs.name: new-site
outputs.desc: The built and tested new site

outputs.name: redesign-project-plan
outputs.desc: Complete project record including goals, design decisions, launch date, and post-launch measurement plan

process: Build the new site following the approved mockups.
Migrate and update content per the content plan.
Test thoroughly: content, functionality, performance, accessibility.
Set up redirects from old URLs, switch DNS, and monitor post-launch.
